name: Inbox — Resolve Conversation
primary_task: Open an inbound conversation, read its context, and reply or triage.
success_state: The conversation re-rendered after a successful reply (POST + 303) with a persistent success banner.
failure_recovery: 422 preserves the reply draft with inline alert + validation summary; unknown conversation renders error-state 404 with retry (R-ERROR-01/02).
no_js_flow: Complete: reply is a native POST form + 303; refresh reloads with an inline toast; the inbox list (planned screen) is reached by real links.
htmx_enhancement: hx-get swaps #thread-panel on refresh (fragment + HX-Trigger loom:toast). Reply stays POST + 303 (no hx-post).
